definitions: Selecting a mixture of what appears to be best of various doctrines, methods or styles.
Someone who selects according to the eclectic method.

entries.title: Eclectic (Eric Johnson and Mike Stern album)

blocks.text: Eclectic is collaborative album between American guitarists Eric Johnson and Mike Stern. It was released on October 27, 2014. It was Johnson's first studio release since his 2010 album Up Close. The album features guest appearances by Malford Milligan and Christopher Cross.

Eclectic is a live album by the Scottish rock band Big Country, released in 1996 by Castle Communications. It was produced by Big Country and Gary Langan, and reached No. 41 in the UK. In 2001, a video version of Eclectic was released under the same name by Castle.
